message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The 24-hour window was 2026-08-05 23:40 UTC through 2026-08-06 23:40 UTC (2026-08-06 05:10 IST through 2026-08-07 05:10 IST). Confirmed in-scope activity includes a Google Chrome update covering 41 newly published CVEs. Two critical Dell Virtual Storage Integrator issues are also plausibly relevant to monitored VMware vSphere environments. A large set of WordPress plugin and theme disclosures needs inventory matching before exposure can be confirmed.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: CVE-2026-19137 through CVE-2026-19177 (41 CVEs)
- Severity: 6 Critical and 35 High, per Google/Chromium
- Summary: Chrome versions before 151.0.7922.109 contain a broad set of memory-safety, sandbox-escape, code-execution, information-disclosure, site-isolation, and privilege-escalation flaws. Several require a compromised renderer or platform-specific conditions, while others can be reached through crafted web content.
- Relevance: The CVE records explicitly identify Google Chrome, which is on the monitored list.
- Source: [Google Chrome Stable Channel update](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/08/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01193673229.html)

### Possible matches needing review

**Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Client**

- Issue: CVE-2026-67261
- Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.8)
- Summary: Versions before 10.11.1.0 allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject OS commands and execute them as root.
- Relevance uncertainty: This is a Dell integration for VMware vSphere Client, not VMware vCenter or ESXi itself. It is relevant only if the Dell VSI component is deployed.
- Source: [Dell DSA-2026-335](https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/000496035/dsa-2026-335-security-update-for-dell-virtual-storage-integrator-for-vmware-vsphere-client-multiple-vulnerabilities)

- Issue: CVE-2026-54489
- Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.1)
- Summary: Versions before 10.11.1.0 can disclose active session credentials to an unauthenticated remote attacker, enabling administrator impersonation.
- Relevance uncertainty: This affects the same optional Dell vSphere Client integration rather than vCenter or ESXi directly.
- Source: [Dell DSA-2026-335](https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/000496035/dsa-2026-335-security-update-for-dell-virtual-storage-integrator-for-vmware-vsphere-client-multiple-vulnerabilities)

**WordPress plugins and themes**

- Scope: 27 newly published CVEs map to third-party WordPress plugins or themes; 25 carry Critical CNA ratings and 2 have no clearly stated CNA severity. These do not affect WordPress core by default and require comparison with the installed plugin/theme inventory.
- Highest-impact groups:
  - Unauthenticated backdoor or arbitrary upload: CVE-2026-14812 (Premium SEO, CVSS 10.0) and CVE-2026-66665 (Type Hub, CVSS 10.0).
  - Remote code execution: CVE-2026-65553 (Spider Analyser, CVSS 10.0), CVE-2026-65548 (Betheme, CVSS 9.9), and CVE-2026-66709 (CTX Feed, CVSS 9.1).
  - Unauthenticated privilege escalation: CVE-2026-66662, CVE-2026-65507, and CVE-2026-28005 (each CVSS 9.8).
  - Unauthenticated SQL injection: CVE-2026-65546, CVE-2026-65520, CVE-2026-66447, and CVE-2026-65508 (each CVSS 9.3); CVE-2026-12713 also describes unauthenticated SQL injection, but the CNA record does not clearly state severity.
  - PHP object injection: CVE-2026-65571 through CVE-2026-65579 (except CVE-2026-65580), CVE-2026-65581, CVE-2026-65552, CVE-2026-65556, and CVE-2026-28139 (each CVSS 9.8).
  - File deletion: CVE-2026-16054 affects Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload for WooCommerce before 1.1.8; severity is not clearly stated in the CNA record.
- Sources: [WPScan: Premium SEO](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/0115a640-7139-4ef9-81be-6ee5c755a601/), [Patchstack: Type Hub](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/typehub/vulnerability/wordpress-type-hub-plugin-2-0-6-arbitrary-file-upload-vulnerability?_s_id=cve), [Patchstack: Spider Analyser](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/spider-analyser/vulnerability/wordpress-spider-analyser-wordpress-plugin-2-1-3-remote-code-execution-rce-vulnerability?_s_id=cve), [Patchstack: Betheme](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/theme/betheme/vulnerability/wordpress-betheme-theme-28-4-2-remote-code-execution-rce-vulnerability?_s_id=cve), [Patchstack: WP OAuth Server](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/miniorange-oauth-20-server/vulnerability/wordpress-wp-oauth-server-plugin-6-2-0-sql-injection-vulnerability?_s_id=cve), [WPScan: WPCargo](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/5fecb389-c327-4084-a5c8-61e5098386d6/)

Immediate review is recommended for Chrome deployments. Check for Dell VSI in VMware environments and compare the WordPress plugin/theme list against deployed inventory; the critical ratings justify prompt action when a match exists. No other monitored product had a confirmed, in-window match after freshness, product-mapping, credibility, and duplicate checks.
